# Hi, I'm Luca 👋

I hold an M.Sc. in Applied Psychology from the University of Trieste, where I
specialized in statistical genomics and biological psychiatry.

I am currently a visiting scholar at the
[Behavior, Environment, and Genetics Lab](https://sites.wustl.edu/emmajohnsonlab/)
at WashU in St. Louis, MO, USA, working on the genomics of psychiatric traits
and machine-learning approaches to biomedical data.

## Research Interests

::: {.research-list}
- Neuropsychiatry genomics
- Statistical genomics for complex traits
- Bayesian hierarchical modelling of RNA-seq trajectories
- Longitudinal genetic models
:::
